basis.decisions: DECIDED by the owner on 2026-10-20 (not proposals): (D1) the gazetteer period-assignment act (Spec 027 section 6.2) is authorised, bundled with the D-25 chronology test - one adjudication cycle, this act executes first, D-25's own spec consumes the assigned gazetteer as a hash-pinned input; (D2) the evidence standard is Option 1 - published period determinations only, no program-derived assignments (Option 2 not adopted). Open for the freeze: DD-039-1 (label set), DD-039-2 (source hierarchy), DD-039-3 (TwoRains published-venue rule), DD-039-4 (Masudpur establishment; recommended default no), DD-039-5 (margins re-run as this act's verification step), DD-039-6 (the spec's own OSF contract registration; proposal yes).

design.phase: Phase-401 (provisional label at draft; the execution takes the next free phase number at freeze - DD-039-7)
design.act: assign program period labels to the Stage 0 gazetteer sites (36 rows, 30 program sites) in the section 6.2 program_period_assignment field, from published determinations only, under rules frozen before any assignment is made

evidence_standard.admissible: a publication's own period statement about the named site, cited with its locator (page, table, or record)
evidence_standard.inadmissible: chronology-spine dates and any inference from them; neighbouring-site analogy; site-size or survey reasoning; unpublished data; the program's own prior prose; any determination that cannot be cited to a publication and a locator
evidence_standard.restricted_sources: Possehl's lists and Law (2011) stand catalogue_only and the CISI catalogue layers open_access_read_only in the Stage 0 record; assignments resting on them record citation, locator, and the determination as published - no bulk copying or redistribution (Spec 027 section 5.1 posture)
evidence_standard.no_program_derived: Option 2 (published plus program-derived assignments under frozen rules, e.g. spine dates to period) was not adopted; no label is an inference

label_set.alignment: the vocabulary of Spec 031's frozen period rule (adopted 4A; F031-C10), which turns on Mature Harappan occupation and attempts no finer temporal slicing
label_set.outside_the_sequence: a published determination outside the Harappan sequence (e.g. the gazetteer's own PN / Neo. values) grounds no assignment under this set
label_set.multi_period: a multi-period occupation statement grounds a multi-label record stated as such, never silently collapsed

mapping_rule.form: a scheme-aware table, written into the freeze record before any assignment is made; the row's period_scheme governs which mapping applies
mapping_rule.unmapped_values: a value with no table entry maps to nothing: the site stays unassigned on that evidence, reason code UNMAPPED_SCHEME_VALUE; no mapping is improvised at assignment time
mapping_rule.recorded_per_assignment: the mapping entry applied, the reviewer of record, and every determination relied on (source, citation, locator, published value, scheme)

disagreement.posture: Spec 027 sections 6.3 and 6.5: contested assignments are flagged, every conflicting determination stays on the record verbatim, no majority vote silently resolves a conflict, and downstream consumers report both ways (contested counted / contested excluded)
disagreement.hierarchy_limit: the DD-039-2 source hierarchy orders citation and presentation only; it never suppresses a determination and never resolves a contest
disagreement.ask2_reserved: Spec 030 Ask 2 (CONTESTED sensitivity bindingness for a future Q6 freeze) is expressly NOT DECIDED and stays RESERVED; this act does not decide it, does not depend on it, and does not prejudge it - different fields in different records

assignment_record.unit: per program_site_id (30 sites), carried identically onto every gazetteer row for that site
assignment_record.shape: label or label set; mapping_rule; reviewer; evidence list (source, citation, locator, published value, scheme); contested flag with the conflicting determinations where set

outputs.assigned_gazetteer: data/movement/gazetteer_rows_assigned.jsonl - all 36 rows, byte-identical to the pre-act file outside program_period_assignment; the pre-act file is not modified and its SHA-256 is pinned in the outcome record
outputs.assignment_report: reports/phaseNNN_results.json and reports/phaseNNN_gazetteer_assignment_report.md (phase number fixed at freeze): per-site table with evidence, contested list, blank list with reason codes, the section 6.3 completeness report by source
outputs.dataset_new_version: a NEW VERSION of Zenodo record 23300361 carrying the assigned gazetteer for the releasable rows under v1's licence posture; the existing deposit is never edited

margins_verification.scope: recompute only the period-eligibility gate of the Phase-395 margins step, under Spec 031's frozen rule (F031-C10), over the assigned gazetteer; eligible sites reported both ways over contested assignments
margins_verification.then_stated: the margins step's remaining frozen floors and the standing record against them: in-universe link mass 2 link-eligible sites and 1 linked pair against floors of 8 eligible sites and 10 linked pairs - on the standing record the step closes at the link-mass floor, recorded as a verification result, not as a Q7 verdict
margins_verification.never_reopened: no response is computed; no Spec 031 machinery beyond the margins first gate runs; Spec 031's closures (bead/craft NOT-YET-TESTABLE, ceramic NOT ESTIMABLE) are not amended, superseded, or restated

bundle.partner: D-25, the chronology-controlled re-test of Spec 025 G1 (SUPPORTED under control; chronology not controlled - the rider), design in the PR #195 portfolio
bundle.sequencing: one adjudication cycle covers both acts; this act executes first; D-25's spec is a separate document consuming the assigned gazetteer as a hash-pinned input; this spec does not design, freeze, or prejudge D-25's test

masudpur.dd: DD-039-4 (recommended default carried in the contract)
masudpur.state: 28 TwoRains determinations (Masudpur VII, Masudpur I) extracted in full in the Phase-394 record and NOT ADMITTED: the sites are not gazetteer-established and no publication reached states their coordinates; Phase-394 rule 7 admits coordinate-less rows only for gazetteer-established sites
masudpur.default: this act establishes no new sites and admits no Masudpur determination; the act is confined to the existing 30 sites, and the establishment route stays recorded for a future act
masudpur.tworains_venue_rule: DD-039-3: a TwoRains determination counts as published only in a peer-reviewed journal article, its published supplementary material, or a published report series, with a locator; theses, project datasets, and data deposits do not count; doubtful venues default to not counting

design.fences: assignments are published-record statements, not dating evidence; the act changes no study verdict by itself; link mass (2 sites / 1 pair) is unaffected and is stated wherever the act's effect is described; a blank is an honest outcome, recorded with its reason code
design.execution_gate: NOT satisfied: this draft performs no freeze and no execution; the freeze and the execution are later acts in the bundle sequence (plan.md section 2), and no period assignment has been made

inputs.spec031_period_rule: specs/031-stage2-q7-provenance-networks/spec.md section 6 (adopted 4A; F031-C10): a site is period-eligible iff its Stage 0 gazetteer period_label_as_published or Stage 0 program period assignment indicates Mature Harappan occupation as published; no finer temporal slicing is attempted
